# Defined references

[Full][label], [Label][] and [label], an image ![alt][image] and a footnote[^note].

A [shortcut] without definition is fine by default, and so is [text][x].

Brackets in `[code][undefined]` and escaped \[text\]\[undefined\] are not links.

```text
[code][undefined]
```

[label]: https://example.com
[image]: image.png
[^note]: A footnote.
